'''Fire Wave''' is a [[Fire spells|fire]]-based [[Wave spells|wave spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 75 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]]. 

It is the second-strongest fire spell in the game, with the strongest being [[Fire Surge]].

== Damage ==
Fire Wave has a base maximum hit of 20. As with all combat spells, this maximum hit is increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As a fire-based spell, Fire Wave's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to fire]].
